description:
Jin Yeong-Won, an unregistered special forces sergeant, has deliberately avoided using his abilities as a Sentinel for years. But when his hidden power is exposed, he is forcibly transferred into a classified unit where Sentinels are weapons, not choices. There, Yeong-Won meets Captain Myeong Hae-Jun, an A-rank Guide assigned to stabilize him. From the start, Yeong-Won resists, haunted by the trauma of the day his powers first awakened. He refuses to fight as a Sentinel, believing that using his ability again will only drag him back into that nightmare. Command does not agree. Orders come down for Hae-Jun to deploy Yeong-Won into active combat, regardless of his condition. Then one night, air raid sirens pierce the base. As explosions echo overhead, Yeong-Won is thrown back seven years, forced to relive the moment that broke him. 

With danger closing in and trust still unformed, both men must decide whether survival is possible without confronting the past head-on. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*
